_comment: Inputs of folly's generic HookOS UKI and its own fleet-boot UKIs, which .github/workflows/talos-images.yml signs. hookos is a tinkerbell/hook release and the sha512 of its hook_latest-lts-x86_64.tar.gz, as its checksum.txt lists it; Renovate bumps both together. The containers workflow's delivery rewrites tink_agent_image when images/tink-agent-autoid builds, and fleet_boot_alpine_image when images/fleet-boot-alpine builds; an all-zero digest is no image yet, and the release carries no Alpine UKI until one is pinned. fleet_boot.kernel is the nixpkgs kernel package set nix/images/fleet-boot.nix boots, a series the owner moves by hand. menu_default is the iPXE menu item a netboot takes when nobody picks one, hookos, fleetboot or alpine, and spore's fleetd executor must run the same: tinkerbell for hookos, boot for the other two.
